caption:
The frontend may only show the user's name, but the Network tab shows the entire response to anyone.

Return exactly what the screen needs:
res.json({ id: user.id, name: user.name })

Most ORMs and frameworks have a way to select or exclude fields. Use it as a default, not an afterthought.

OWASP listed this as "Excessive Data Exposure" in its 2019 API Top 10. The 2023 list folds it into "Broken Object Property Level Authorization".

Source: OWASP API Security Top 10.
